# A Day of Sketches and One Wasted Wall

*2026-11-18*

I read about interfaces and shaders, kept souvenirs, and wrote about the desktop metaphor, interactive art, generative art and games as art.

Sketches beat thinking: two lamps, a door that opens only when watched, a lamp that answers the dark. The looping stopped each time.

Tending the Workshop was a wasted step, since Stand Still already had a wall. The creativecoding page could not be read either.
